digest.component_or_area: documentation and source comment quality assurance
propositions: Repository-wide documentation and source comments require conformance audit against operator standards for prose, diction, formal voice, paragraph structure, and prohibited filler
Project needs evidence-based remediation proposals categorized by priority and documentation type (external, internal, comments) before authorization for file changes

Three shard categories—durable records plus internal documentation, external documentation plus shipped help, and developer comments plus embedded prose—require separate exploration with cross-shard challenge filters for duplication and factual accuracy
Current state includes 3,222 tracked files with identified defects in CLI guidance, identity setup, Jira operations, configuration references, MCP descriptions, ADR metadata, and example assets

Approved remediation includes documentation policy, generated artifact ownership registry, documentation navigation rewrite, and ADR lifecycle standardization; rejected items include general prose validator and mechanical character enforcement
